jobs.title: Associate Director, IOCC Transformation & Innovation
jobs.description:
Toronto Pearson is transforming. Now’s the time for your career to fly.

The Greater Toronto Airports Authority (GTAA) is a unique and dynamic place to work, with a bold plan to make Toronto Pearson, Canada’s leading global hub airport, a global leader in airport performance, customer care and sustainability. Together with our partners, approximately 2,100 GTAA employees are working to create a next-generation airport by innovating in all we do and striving for the most uplifting, safe and efficient experience for our passengers – all while championing the prosperity of our people, the community we call home, and our aviation partners. Join us on our journey together, as we put the joy back into travel and make Toronto Pearson the chosen place to fly and work.

What's in it for you?

An opportunity to grow, develop, and thrive within a dynamic, and fast-growing company alongside thoughtful and passionate individuals dedicated to their work and community.
Comprehensive benefits, including a flexible retirement program with employer matching, along with voluntary savings options (RRSP, TFSA, and Non-Registered Savings Plans).
A flexible work environment, continuous internal and external learning opportunities, and a meaningful reward and recognition program.

What can you expect from this position?

Reporting to the Director, IOCC, the Associate Director, IOCC Transformation & Innovation is responsible for leading the transformation of Toronto Pearson's Integrated Operations Control Centre into a predictive, technology-enabled, collaborative airport operations model. This role will translate operational modernization strategy into sustainable capabilities across people, processes, technology, data, governance, and partner collaboration.

As a strategic leader, you will drive the development and implementation of innovative operating models, digital capabilities, analytics, performance frameworks, and transformation initiatives that improve operational resilience, passenger experience, airport performance, and decision-making. You will lead a multidisciplinary team and work across the airport ecosystem to deliver operational excellence and future-ready capabilities that support one of Canada's most complex transportation environments.

As an Associate Director, IOCC Transformation and Innovation, you will:

Lead the development and execution of a multi-year transformation roadmap that advances airport operational excellence.
Drive transformation initiatives from concept through implementation, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
Establish innovative operating models, governance structures, and collaborative decision-making practices across airport stakeholders.
Lead the evolution of operational systems, digital tools, analytics platforms, and data-driven decision-support capabilities.
Develop and govern airport-wide performance frameworks, key performance indicators, and service level agreements.
Champion innovation through the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies, industry best practices, and new operating models.
Provide strategic operational planning, forecasting, and analytics capabilities that support proactive and predictive operations.
Partner with internal and external stakeholders to align priorities, improve performance, and deliver transformation initiatives.
Lead and develop teams responsible for transformation, operational planning, systems, digital enablement, and business analytics.
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

This is the role for you, if you have:

8+ years of progressive leadership experience, including experience leading large-scale transformation, modernization, or technology-enabled change programs.
5+ years of people leadership experience within a complex matrix environment.
Experience within aviation, transportation, logistics, infrastructure, operations, or similarly complex operational environments.
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional programs involving business, technology, operational, regulatory, and external stakeholders.
Experience delivering operational systems, analytics capabilities, digital tools, and business transformation initiatives.
Strong change management, stakeholder engagement, strategic planning, and business transformation capabilities.
Strong understanding of data, analytics, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.
Bachelor’s degree in aviation management, Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
Professional certifications such as PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Prosci, Agile, or Data Analytics.
Valid Ontario Driver's License.
Ability to obtain and retain Transportation Security Clearance at the designated level for the position.

The GTAA is committed to Employment Equity and maintaining a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

This position is exempt from Ontario's 2026 pay transparency requirements under Regulation 476/24.

jobs.description:
Career opportunities are presented in the language received.

Nunavut Housing Corporation | Iqaluit, Nunavut | Full-time

About Nunavut Housing Corporation

The Nunavut Housing Corporation (NHC) is an arm’s-length public agency of the Government of Nunavut (GN) and the driving force in housing policy, program delivery, and construction across Nunavut’s 25 communities. With an operating budget of more than $230 million and a capital budget of approximately $171 million, NHC is leading Nunavut 3000, an estimated $1.6 billion plan to build 3,000 new homes over 10 years.

About The Role

Reporting to the President & CEO and serving on the Corporate Executive Committee, the VP, Finance and Corporate Services leads finance, human resources, IT, and policy and strategic planning, with five direct reports and functional oversight for approximately 350 employees across 25 Local Housing Organizations (LHOs). The VP also serves as President & CEO as required.

Key Responsibilities

Financial leadership: Steward NHC’s financial health, advise the executive team, and represent NHC with the GN, CMHC, Cabinet, the Financial Management Board, and the Legislature.
People and culture: Lead a newly established HR function and build a strong workforce, with a deliberate focus on Inuit employment, training, and development.
Technology: Oversee the systems and IT services that support NHC and all 25 LHOs, strengthening digital capacity and data security for growth.
Policy and strategy: Shape NHC’s policies, plans, and research, and support the Minister’s office.

What We’re Looking For

A dynamic, transformational leader who will modernize and integrate corporate services, simplifying processes and raising performance as NHC grows.
Hands-on and ready to act, making an immediate impact by strengthening the finance function and building depth across the team.
An innovative, steady executive who brings fresh approaches to partnerships, funding, and procurement, and leads with confidence through change.
A coach and people builder who develops talent, especially Nunavut Inuit, and communicates complex issues clearly and respectfully.

Qualifications

CPA designation and at least 10 years of progressive senior finance and management experience, ideally in the public sector, a Crown corporation, or housing.
Strong command of public-sector budgeting, financial administration, and audit.
Knowledge of Nunavut, the Nunavut Agreement, and the roles of Inuit organizations.
Housing experience and fluency in more than one of Nunavut’s official languages are assets; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Priority will be given to Nunavut Inuit who self-identify as being enrolled under the Nunavut Agreement, in accordance with the GN Priority Hiring Policy.

Salary: $160,374 to $229,106 per year, plus Northern Allowance and subsidized housing.

Closing date: November 25, 2026.

This position is a Position of Trust, a criminal record check required. AI will not be used in candidate screening.

To apply, submit your application to Phelps by clicking: https://phelpsgroup.ca/careers/31837/nunavut-housing-corporation-vp-finance-corp-services/apply/(opens in a new tab)

jobs.title: Head of Data Analytics - Veeva Ostro
jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Ostro operates as a startup within Veeva, and sits at the intersection of life sciences, marketing, and artificial intelligence. We empower pharmaceutical brands, healthcare providers (HCPs), and patients by orchestrating AI-enabled omnichannel engagement across the entire patient and prescriber lifecycle.

As the Head of Data Analytics
, you will lead the design, development, and continuous improvement of the data systems and associated measurement analyses that sit at the intersection of our products, customers, and commercial strategy. Our products generate significant data as users ask questions and take action, and you will work with the product team to surface and execute on insights that govern how our product evolves. This data is also used by our customers in their planning efforts, and you will work closely with our client service and implementation teams to enable and deliver on customized analyses that reflect the nuances of each client’s strategy. To deliver on the above, you will proactively architect, build, and scale the next generation of our data platform to make it modern, scalable, and AI-ready.

As the leader of the Data Analytics team, you will contribute to the team in a “player / coach” capacity, providing both executive leadership and hands-on expertise and contributions.

What You'll Do

Modern Data Architecture & Engineering: Work alongside platform and data engineers to upgrade our existing data architecture to be high fidelity, AI-ready, and easily accessible for both internal and external users
Customer Data Integrations: Guide the execution of data integrations into select customer systems in partnership with our solutions engineering team
Product Analyses: Uplevel our standard suite of analytics and measurement insights in partnership with our product team
Custom Analyses: Execute on client-specific, custom analytical requests in partnership with our client services team
Leadership & Team Mentorship: Direct and grow a team of data analysts and data engineers

Requirements

Deep, hands-on expertise in SQL / Python and strong capabilities in data modeling, advanced quantitative analysis, and working with large data sets
Strong command of modern data architecture particularly in enabling AI readiness. You will not be the sole engineer building every component yourself, but you need enough technical depth to actively participate in the design and build
10+ years of progressive experience in data science/analytics and/or data engineering roles including in a managerial capacity leading teams
Recent work experience should relate to the pharmaceutical / life sciences industry
Undergrad or masters in a technical discipline (computer science, statistics, engineering, math, physics, etc.)

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

Follow the application process and submit your resume.
If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A personality assessment (unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously)
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader

Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
PTO and company-paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program

Compensation

Base pay: $200,000 - $300,000 CAD
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

About Avid

Avid makes technology and collaborative tools so creators can entertain, inform, educate and enlighten the world. Our customers are the visionaries behind the most inspiring feature films, television programs, news broadcasts, televised sporting events, music recording and live concerts.
To learn how Avid powers greater creators or for more information, visit www.avid.com.

Job Summary

Reporting to the CIO, the Sr. Director, Finance Systems will lead the delivery, optimization, and ongoing evolution of Avid’s core finance technology ecosystem, with primary accountability for NetSuite ERP and NetSuite Planning & Budgeting (NSPB). This leader will ensure finance systems are reliable, scalable, well-controlled, and aligned with business priorities while driving continuous improvement and modernization.

This role requires a strong combination of technical depth, financial systems expertise, operational discipline, and people leadership. The Director will manage a team of engineers and finance systems professionals, ensuring effective Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, consistent roadmap execution, and high-quality delivery. The Director will also build strong partnerships with Finance and cross-functional stakeholders through clear communication, roadmap transparency, and reliable execution.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategy & Leadership

Lead a team of approximately 2-3 team members consisting of FTEs and contingent workers.
Contribute to and execute against a multi-year vision and roadmap for Finance Systems aligned with company strategy and priorities.
Serve as a trusted partner to Finance leadership, translating financial process needs into practical, scalable technology solutions.
Drive continuous improvement, simplification, and modernization across the finance application portfolio, with a focus on NetSuite and NSPB.

Delivery & Execution

Oversee the design, development, and implementation of enhancements across:
NetSuite ERP
NetSuite Planning & Budgeting (NSPB)
Finance-related integrations with Salesforce, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems
RevPro (Zuora) revenue recognition
Concur Expense Management
Establish and maintain strong SDLC practices to ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.
Ensure roadmap commitments are met through effective planning, prioritization, and execution.
Balance long-term strategic initiatives with the need for quick wins that deliver immediate business value to Finance and the broader organization.

NetSuite & Finance Systems Ownership

Serve as the primary technology leader for NetSuite ERP and NSPB.
Ensure financial system configurations, workflows, and integrations support accurate reporting, forecasting, and financial operations.
Partner with Accounting, FP&A, and Finance Operations to continuously optimize system usage and automation.
Define and improve finance data flows between NetSuite, Salesforce, Snowflake, and other enterprise platforms.
Support system scalability as the business grows and evolves.

Delivery & Technical Leadership

Lead and develop a high-performing Finance Systems team, including engineers and functional specialists.
Upskill talent where needed through role optimization, targeted training, and thoughtful hiring.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Establish strong partnerships with stakeholders across:
Finance (Accounting, FP&A, Revenue, Finance Operations)
Business Applications
Data & Analytics
Technology and Engineering
Sales, Operations, and Product teams
Maintain transparency into progress, risks, and trade-offs through clear communication and reporting.

Operations & Governance

Support system reliability, performance, and security across all finance platforms.
Help define and implement effective governance models for changes, data integrity, and integrations.
Ensure strong controls, auditability, and compliance within NetSuite and connected systems.
Manage relationships with key vendors and third-party partners as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Keys to Success

Deep technical and functional expertise in NetSuite ERP and NSPB.
Strong understanding of finance processes, reporting, and planning.
Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
Demonstrated ability to deliver both strategic outcomes and practical, near-term wins.
Effective people leader who develops and elevates talent.
Proven ability to facilitate and lead cross-functional prioritization discussions.
Track record of delivering against committed roadmaps with quality and predictability.

Required Skills

10+ years of experience working with enterprise finance systems, business applications, or similar functions.
5+ years of people management experience, including leading technical or engineering teams.
Expert-level experience with NetSuite ERP and NetSuite Planning & Budgeting (NSPB).
Working knowledge of Salesforce (CRM and Billing) and how it integrates with finance systems.
Working knowledge of modern SDLC practices and agile delivery methodologies.
Experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce, Snowflake or other cloud data warehouse, Middleware or iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Mulesoft, Boomi, etc.)
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives or major programs of work.
Experience supporting audit, SOX controls, or financial compliance initiatives.
Experience in SaaS, technology, or digitally driven businesses.

What to look forward to?

Join a global team and experience a dynamic, collaborative work environment that fosters innovation and growth.
Remote work model offering flexibility to balance work and life.
Access to development programs with strong support and mentoring to help you grow and advance within the company.
Equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusivity, and creating a welcoming environment for all employees.
Attractive benefits package including health & life insurance, referral rewards, and generous leave policies to ensure a healthy work-life balance.

Act as a recognized leader and internal subject matter expert on employee benefits matters, supporting business priorities as well as talent attraction, engagement, and retention.

Define and evolve the strategies, policies, programs, and technology platforms that support the employee benefits offering.

Advise leadership teams on complex and strategic matters.

jobs.title: Head of Finance - R&D
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Finance - R&D based in Canada.

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on finance leader to oversee the financial and banking infrastructure of a portfolio of fast-growing international technology businesses.

In this role, you will shape a multi-jurisdictional banking network, strengthen payment operations, and manage complex treasury activities across multiple entities.

You will drive liquidity management, optimize foreign exchange and transaction costs, and ensure reliable cross-border financial flows.

Working closely with founders and senior leaders, you will contribute to financial strategy, business performance, and investment decisions.

You will also build scalable treasury and finance processes from the ground up while developing a high-performing operational team.

This is an opportunity to take full ownership of a complex financial ecosystem and support the growth of ambitious digital businesses in a dynamic, international environment.

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

As Head of Finance - R&D, you will lead the development and management of the financial infrastructure, treasury operations, and banking partnerships supporting international technology businesses. Your main responsibilities will include:

Banking and Payment Infrastructure
Design and implement a flexible, multi-jurisdictional banking network for international digital businesses operating under demanding compliance requirements.
Identify, negotiate with, and onboard strategic financial partners, including leading banks, Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), Payment Service Providers (PSPs), custodians, and financial platforms.
Negotiate favorable commercial terms, including transaction fees, payment terms, foreign exchange rates, and hedging instruments.
Establish backup banking relationships and alternative payment channels to ensure uninterrupted transaction processing.

Treasury and Liquidity Management
Manage multi-currency liquidity, working capital, cash pooling, and treasury operations across a group of legal entities.
Oversee complex international transfers through SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, and other payment networks, prioritizing speed, security, and cost efficiency.
Monitor and reduce treasury expenses, including FX spreads, acquiring fees, and banking charges.

Compliance, KYC, and Regulatory Strategy
Coordinate banking due diligence and maintain effective communication with bank compliance and risk teams.
Ensure the long-term stability of banking relationships and payment flows.
Support financial restructuring, corporate changes, and related banking and compliance requirements.

Financial Systems and Executive Partnership
Build integrated treasury and financial processes from the ground up.
Partner with founders and senior leadership on unit economics, ROI analysis, and financial modeling.
Recruit, lead, and develop the treasury and operational finance team.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines senior finance leadership experience with strong expertise in international treasury operations, banking infrastructure, and financial compliance. You should bring:

At least 5 years of experience as a CFO, VP of Finance, or Head of Treasury in fast-growing businesses.
A proven track record of opening corporate bank accounts and establishing efficient payment processes.
Deep knowledge of international AML/KYC principles, cross-border compliance, and regulatory requirements across different jurisdictions.
Practical experience managing multi-currency funds, foreign exchange exposure, financial settlement instruments, and transaction cost optimization.
Strong negotiation skills and the ability to manage complex relationships with banks, legal advisors, and financial service providers.
Advanced English proficiency (C1/C2), with the ability to lead detailed, persuasive negotiations independently.
Strong strategic thinking, financial judgment, and the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with founders and executive stakeholders.

Benefits

High level of autonomy: Full ownership of the financial and banking infrastructure, with minimal unnecessary bureaucracy.
Meaningful business impact: Direct involvement in launching and scaling new technology businesses serving millions of users.
Strong professional environment: Collaboration with experienced founders and talented engineering and marketing professionals.
Dedicated platform support: Access to more than 10 specialized teams providing expertise in recruitment, communications, finance, legal matters, and other operational areas.
Founder community: Opportunities to exchange practical knowledge and experience with entrepreneurs who have successfully launched multiple businesses.
Professional communities: Access to internal groups focused on product, marketing, engineering, and payments.
Learning and development: Training programs, professional courses, and opportunities to attend industry conferences.
Healthcare: Medical insurance.
Social impact: The opportunity to contribute to initiatives supporting recovery and addressing the consequences of the war in Ukraine.

jobs.description:
About Toronto Metropolitan

For more than 75 years, Toronto Metropolitan University (formerly known as Ryerson University) has been shaping the next generation of leaders through its uniquely innovative, entrepreneurial and career-focused approach to higher education. Driven by bold leadership, cutting-edge research and a deep commitment to academic excellence, TMU collaborates with students, faculties, staff and partners to push boundaries, reimagine solutions and create meaningful change in an increasingly interconnected world.

For a more in-depth understanding of our vision, core values and ongoing work, please see our academic plan

TMU welcomes those who have demonstrated a commitment to upholding the values of equity, diversity, and inclusion and will assist us in realizing the benefits of embedding these values into the work at every level and in every unit of the university. In addition, to correct the conditions of disadvantage in employment in Canada and to bring lived experiences to the work, we encourage applications from members of equity deserving groups that have been historically disadvantaged and marginalized, including First Nations, Métis and Inuit Peoples in Canada, First Nations Peoples in the United States, racialized people, Black people, persons with disabilities, women, and 2SLGBTQ+ people. Preference will be given to candidates with lived experiences as people from equity deserving groups, as well as experience working with these communities with which the University works every day. Please note that all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply and we welcome newcomers and immigrants to Canada.

In April 2022, the university announced its new name of Toronto Metropolitan University. Learn more about our next chapter.

About The School Of Medicine

It’s time to transform medical education. Toronto Metropolitan University’s School of Medicine has been designed from the ground up to shift the paradigm of healthcare delivery and improve the well-being of individuals, families and communities. With a community-driven, intentionally inclusive approach, the new school is training doctors whose cultural awareness and humility are as crucial as their medical skills.

Led by Dr. Teresa M. Chan, a forward-thinking educational leader, TMU’s School of Medicine draws on the university’s commitment to community, equity, and innovation to address rapidly changing healthcare needs. The school will train a new generation of physicians who are ready to learn, to adapt, and ultimately to be agents of change.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Finance Director to join the School of Medicine! This newly created role leads the development and implementation of school-wide financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and resource management strategies that advance the academic, research, and operational priorities of the School of Medicine.

Serving as a trusted strategic advisor, the position provides expert financial counsel to the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO), the Dean, and senior leadership by assessing long-term financial implications, recommending evidence-based solutions, and ensuring alignment with broader University policies, procedures, and governance frameworks.

This role oversees the financial operations of the School of Medicine, supporting budgeting, reporting, financial compliance, and informed decision-making. he Director also provides financial and advisory support to the Integrated Health Centre, including support for external financial reporting and audit requirements,, in close collaboration with TMU Financial Services and the University Planning Office.

In addition, the Director conducts financial research and analysis to inform policy development and long-term planning, and represents the CAO and the School of Medicine in TMU-wide planning discussions and committees.

Responsibilities Include

Financial planning, budgeting and management

Provides financial advice, analysis, and decision-support to departments within the School of Medicine to support budget development, financial planning, forecasting, and effective resource management.
Manages day-to-day financial activities for the School of Medicine, including monitoring and reconciling operating and payroll expenditures, and ensures that actual financial results reconcile with approved targets
Collaborates with the University Planning Office (UPO) to support the annual budget development process for the SoM.

Payroll Administration and Financial Oversight (SoM Residents and IHC Employees)

Oversees, reviews, and approves biweekly payroll registers before the third-party vendor releases payments and monthly reconciliations. Investigate unusual variances, adjustments, and exceptions.
Monitors payroll funding requirements, forecast upcoming payroll obligations, and ensure sufficient funds are available in the designated bank account before each payroll withdrawal
Oversee the processes, systems, and internal controls supporting the administration of payroll, benefits, and expense claims for medical learners (residents) and Integrated Health Centre (IHC) staff.
Provide leadership and oversight to staff responsible for processing payroll, benefits, and expenses, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with applicable policies and requirements.
Establish and maintain effective procedures, workflows, and controls to support reliable and efficient administration of these functions.

Strategy and external collaboration

Conducts financial research and analysis to support the Dean and CAO in the development of a funding model for the School of Medicine and the Integrated Health Centres (IHC).
Monitors SOM activities relevant to external funding and reporting obligations, and ensures timely information sharing with relevant stakeholders.
Develops and implements a strategic roadmap for School-wide financial forecasting, planning, and internal financial controls, including long-term budget plan for the SoM that supports the academic, research, and operational priorities.
Provides expert analysis and strategic advice on financial risk management for proposed and approved School initiatives.

Financial evaluation and program analysis

Conducts financial evaluations of revenue-generating proposals and new initiatives, and analyzes program costing reports.

Accounting management, reporting & analysis

Manages a wide range of operating, trust, and project accounts (research and non-research) for the SoM and IHC.
Supports University-wide interim and year-end financial statement audits by coordinating SoM responses, and responds to audit inquiries related to IHC and SoM special purpose audits.
Leads the planning and execution of financial analysis to support strategic and operational decisions, and oversees the development and maintenance of statistical analysis systems and integrated financial tracking tools.

HR management

Manages and supervises staff, assigns and prioritises tasks, establishes goals, sets expectations and evaluates performance.

Qualifications

To help us learn more about you, please provide a cover letter and resume describing how you meet the following required qualifications:

Completion of a university degree program in finance, accounting, business or public administration, or a relevant field.
A minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in financial management within a post-secondary, public sector, or MUSH (municipalities, universities, school boards, hospitals) environment, including experience managing complex budgets, government funding, and resource planning.
Equivalent experience or a combination of equivalent experience and education may be accepted in place of education.
Demonstrated work experience in statistical analysis to support forecasting, financial modelling, and program/project viability assessments.
Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) is an asset.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including variance analysis and financial interpretation.
Knowledge of statistical analysis measurement theory to support forecasting, modelling, and program/project viability assessments.
In-depth knowledge of accounting and finance principles and associated technical and security considerations.
Knowledge of Microsoft Excel/Google Sheet and financial systems/software applications to support modelling and reporting.
Knowledge of post-secondary education systems, funding structures and sector-specific financial issues.
Demonstrated skill in developing and implementing financial policies, procedures and processes for new or evolving business initiatives.
Strong project and time management skills in a fast-paced environment.
Effective communication skills to convey complex financial information with stakeholders.
Troubleshooting skills, particularly in identifying causes of financial variances.
Ability to work on team-based projects, and prepare and present accurate reports to senior management.
Ability to organize and manage a complex financial process with accuracy and consistency.
Systems-wide thinking skills, with ability to assess financial and operational implications across units and stakeholder groups.

Leadership Competencies

Leaders at TMU are required to demonstrate the following Leadership Competencies:

Acts with Integrity: Demonstrates behaviors aligned with high ethical standards and personal integrity and acts in accordance with TMU values.
Builds Relationships of Trust & Collaboration: Actively builds a culture of trust and fosters meaningful relationships.
Leads Inclusively: Creates an inclusive environment where everyone is respected, recognized, empowered to achieve their potential, and valued for their differences.
Demonstrates Organizational Acumen: Understands and respectfully navigates complex internal and external environments using sound judgment, diplomacy, and tact.
Drives Vision & Results: Creates and implements a vision grounded in sound decision-making to achieve desired outcomes.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

What You Can Expect

Tractebel Inc. is expanding its presence in Canada and looking for a Business Development & Commercial Director to accelerate growth across Canada.

Ranked 1st in Hydropower design and 4th in Nuclear by Engineering News-Record’s (ENR) 2025 annual ranking, Tractebel is a global engineering and consulting company dedicated to engineering a carbon-neutral future. Backed by over 150 years of expertise, we deliver top-tier solutions in the Energy, Water, Infrastructure sectors. With 6,000+ passionate experts worldwide, we are part of the ENGIE Group, global leaders in low-carbon energy and services.

In Canada, we combine the agility of a growing business with the strength of a global engineering leader.

This is a unique opportunity to join a global engineering group at a pivotal moment of its Canadian expansion. You will have the mandate to shape markets, build strategic partnerships, create new business lines, and position Tractebel as a trusted engineering partner for some of Canada’s most ambitious energy and infrastructure programs.

If you know the Canadian energy sector, particularly nuclear and hydropower, by heart, and if you are a natural relationship builder who can create trust quickly, open doors with clients and partners, and convert market opportunities into sustainable growth, this role was designed for you.

Essential Job Functions

Identify, qualify, and develop strategic business opportunities in Canada, while leveraging Tractebel’s international expertise and selected global partnerships.
Lead the commercial strategy for major pursuits, from early positioning to proposal submission and contract negotiation.
Build trusted relationships with clients, utilities, developers, public stakeholders, engineering partners, and industrial players.
Develop market intelligence, competitor analysis, client mapping, and commercial action plans.
Contribute to pricing strategy, contractual positioning, and commercial risk assessment.
Coordinate with Tractebel’s global business areas to bring the best expertise to Canadian clients.
Support the Managing Director in shaping Tractebel Canada’s growth strategy and long-term market positioning.
Support executive-level client engagement and represent Tractebel in key industry forums, conferences, and strategic discussions.

What You’ll Bring

You will possess a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent.
You will have a Minimum of ten (10) years of relevant experience in a similar function, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.

Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

RBC is looking for a Director to drive the development and articulation of the RBC Wealth Management (RBC WM) segment strategy. The director will work closely with WM Business Unit (BU) Heads and their designates to shape and align individual BU strategies.

They will also deliver strategic advice on key topics through research, analysis and compelling strategic recommendations (i.e., acting as the internal strategy consultant to senior leaders in WM)

What will you do?

Provide customized strategy development and advisory support at the WM segment level and individual BU level, in collaboration with key partners within RBC WM and across RBC more generally (e.g., Personal & Commercial Banking, Technology & Operations, Finance, Group Risk Management, Enterprise Strategy)
Lead qualitative and quantitative analyses to address strategic issues, opportunities and threats for RBC WM, including synthesizing findings and drafting presentations for senior leaders for review, discussion and decision
Partner closely with senior leaders, strategists, functions and cross-functional project teams to drive strategic reviews of BU strategies, client segments and key initiatives, ensuring growth strategies are well developed, articulated and aligned across businesses and with enterprise priorities
Identify opportunities to deliver greater value to clients and RBC by staying on top of market / client trends, sharing best-practice processes and analytical frameworks, and bringing the outside in (e.g., understanding competitor strategies, looking outside our industry to discover new ideas)

What do you need to succeed?

Must haves

Experience in management consulting or similar experience that requires:
Strong critical thinking skills
Structured storyboarding
Exceptional data analytical and synthesis skills, including ability to discern research information / data and focus on the critical business issues

Demonstrated business and financial acumen around business / client trends and value drivers
Experience with financial modelling / modelling financial drivers
Experience with new / emerging businesses and digital business models preferred
Ability to foster and maintain collaborative relationships across a wide range of stakeholders

Nice-to-haves

Proven ability to communicate with senior executives as well as build and present complex presentations; proficient in PowerPoint, Excel and Word
Ability to deal (and be comfortable) with ambiguity
Ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, challenging and dynamic business environment

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. new_jobs.title: Sr Director, Finance Systems (NetSuite, NSPB focus)
new_jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

About Avid

Avid makes technology and collaborative tools so creators can entertain, inform, educate and enlighten the world. Our customers are the visionaries behind the most inspiring feature films, television programs, news broadcasts, televised sporting events, music recording and live concerts.
To learn how Avid powers greater creators or for more information, visit www.avid.com.

Job Summary

Reporting to the CIO, the Sr. Director, Finance Systems will lead the delivery, optimization, and ongoing evolution of Avid’s core finance technology ecosystem, with primary accountability for NetSuite ERP and NetSuite Planning & Budgeting (NSPB). This leader will ensure finance systems are reliable, scalable, well-controlled, and aligned with business priorities while driving continuous improvement and modernization.

This role requires a strong combination of technical depth, financial systems expertise, operational discipline, and people leadership. The Director will manage a team of engineers and finance systems professionals, ensuring effective Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, consistent roadmap execution, and high-quality delivery. The Director will also build strong partnerships with Finance and cross-functional stakeholders through clear communication, roadmap transparency, and reliable execution.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategy & Leadership

Lead a team of approximately 2-3 team members consisting of FTEs and contingent workers.
Contribute to and execute against a multi-year vision and roadmap for Finance Systems aligned with company strategy and priorities.
Serve as a trusted partner to Finance leadership, translating financial process needs into practical, scalable technology solutions.
Drive continuous improvement, simplification, and modernization across the finance application portfolio, with a focus on NetSuite and NSPB.

Delivery & Execution

Oversee the design, development, and implementation of enhancements across:
NetSuite ERP
NetSuite Planning & Budgeting (NSPB)
Finance-related integrations with Salesforce, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems
RevPro (Zuora) revenue recognition
Concur Expense Management
Establish and maintain strong SDLC practices to ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.
Ensure roadmap commitments are met through effective planning, prioritization, and execution.
Balance long-term strategic initiatives with the need for quick wins that deliver immediate business value to Finance and the broader organization.

NetSuite & Finance Systems Ownership

Serve as the primary technology leader for NetSuite ERP and NSPB.
Ensure financial system configurations, workflows, and integrations support accurate reporting, forecasting, and financial operations.
Partner with Accounting, FP&A, and Finance Operations to continuously optimize system usage and automation.
Define and improve finance data flows between NetSuite, Salesforce, Snowflake, and other enterprise platforms.
Support system scalability as the business grows and evolves.

Delivery & Technical Leadership

Lead and develop a high-performing Finance Systems team, including engineers and functional specialists.
Upskill talent where needed through role optimization, targeted training, and thoughtful hiring.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Establish strong partnerships with stakeholders across:
Finance (Accounting, FP&A, Revenue, Finance Operations)
Business Applications
Data & Analytics
Technology and Engineering
Sales, Operations, and Product teams
Maintain transparency into progress, risks, and trade-offs through clear communication and reporting.

Operations & Governance

Support system reliability, performance, and security across all finance platforms.
Help define and implement effective governance models for changes, data integrity, and integrations.
Ensure strong controls, auditability, and compliance within NetSuite and connected systems.
Manage relationships with key vendors and third-party partners as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Keys to Success

Deep technical and functional expertise in NetSuite ERP and NSPB.
Strong understanding of finance processes, reporting, and planning.
Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
Demonstrated ability to deliver both strategic outcomes and practical, near-term wins.
Effective people leader who develops and elevates talent.
Proven ability to facilitate and lead cross-functional prioritization discussions.
Track record of delivering against committed roadmaps with quality and predictability.

Required Skills

10+ years of experience working with enterprise finance systems, business applications, or similar functions.
5+ years of people management experience, including leading technical or engineering teams.
Expert-level experience with NetSuite ERP and NetSuite Planning & Budgeting (NSPB).
Working knowledge of Salesforce (CRM and Billing) and how it integrates with finance systems.
Working knowledge of modern SDLC practices and agile delivery methodologies.
Experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce, Snowflake or other cloud data warehouse, Middleware or iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Mulesoft, Boomi, etc.)
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives or major programs of work.
Experience supporting audit, SOX controls, or financial compliance initiatives.
Experience in SaaS, technology, or digitally driven businesses.

What to look forward to?

Join a global team and experience a dynamic, collaborative work environment that fosters innovation and growth.
Remote work model offering flexibility to balance work and life.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
